title: Induced EMF expression
description: Essential: The final expression for the induced electromotive force must be correctly derived as E = (B_0 * L^2) / (4π * Δt).

title: Induced current expression
description: Essential: The final expression for the induced current must be correctly derived as I = (B_0 * L * S) / (4π * ρ * Δt).

title: Joule heating power expression
description: Essential: The final expression for the Joule heating power must be correctly derived as P = (B_0^2 * L^3 * S) / (16π^2 * ρ * Δt^2).

title: Application of Faraday's Law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Faraday's law of induction, relating the changing magnetic flux to the induced EMF.

title: Use of ring geometry
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the given circumference L to the radius or area of the ring for calculating magnetic flux.

title: Resistance calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the ring's resistance using its length (circumference), cross-sectional area, and resistivity.

title: Algebraic simplification
description: Optional: The solution shows clear and correct algebraic manipulation to arrive at the final simplified expressions.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution includes a check for dimensional or unit consistency in the final expressions.

title: Incorrect flux area
description: Pitfall: Using the cross-sectional area S instead of the ring's enclosed area when calculating magnetic flux.

title: Sign or factor error
description: Pitfall: Making an algebraic error (e.g., missing a factor of π or 2) in the derivation of the final expressions.
